decisions.reason: The supplement range sits squarely within the firm's established consumer health knowledge and pharmacy channels, so it can interpret market feedback and keep refining the line.
As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint health product draws on strong related knowledge in formulation, regulation and marketing, which supports continued improvement.

The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche with little visibility, but it remains within the firm's supplement expertise and immune products gained relevance after 2020, so learning from its results stays feasible.

The OTC triptan is distant from the firm's core offer, yet the firm's in-house pharmaceutical development, regulatory and quality capabilities give it enough related knowledge to absorb market signals, and it fits the strategy of broadening consumer health.
